card.name: Linking words in contraindication and prohibition lists
card.fires_on: The word "of", "any", or a list comma inside contraindication or "do not" instructions. It fires just before the item being excluded, such as a history of a condition or a part of a device.

modes.label: "of" after history/diagnosis/part
modes.description: The word "of" after "history", "diagnosis" or "any part" in a restriction statement.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Active or past history<< of>> venous thromboembolism,

modes.label: Comma in a list of exclusions
modes.description: A comma inside a list of conditions or prohibited actions, just before the final "or" item.
modes.example: Do not crush, break, dissolve<<,>> or chew capsules.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It marks the small linking words in lists of conditions or actions that a label says to avoid.
